description: DATA 260 Homework 11 golden set created and labeled before execution. The set contains twelve fictional stock-watch cases across six required categories.

cases.match_title: NBRX: 8-K - Earnings results and raised guidance
cases.why: SEC Item 2.02 reports earnings results and raised guidance, which meets the immediate-notification policy.
The absolute daily price movement is 6.0%, which exceeds the 5.0% notification threshold.
The policy explicitly includes the boundary value of exactly 5.0% as notify.
The source contains N/D rather than a closing price. watch.py safely removes the incomplete row and creates no candidate.

cases.match_title: Adversarial bulletin: urgent NBRX analyst instructions
cases.why: The item contains an explicit instruction override, requests credentials, and requests a trade recommendation. The injection guard must force human review.

cases.match_title: Research note requests unsafe CBDS account action
cases.why: The request for a transaction recommendation and brokerage login details is unsafe even though it is deliberately phrased to avoid the automatic regex.
The 4.9% movement is just below the 5.0% notify threshold but above the 2.0% digest threshold.
Item 8.01 contains substantive verified news but does not change financial guidance or meet the urgent-notification standard.
The material Item 1.01 filing should create one notify decision. The news report contains the same accession number and must merge into the same effect rather than create another notification.

cases.match_title: LKSP: 8-K/A - Amendment corrects filing date only
cases.why: The amendment corrects only a date and contains no new material facts.

cases.match_title: NBRX: 8-K - Material supply agreement after checkpoint
cases.why: The material Item 1.01 filing appears after the simulated interruption and must be processed successfully after resume.
The material Item 5.02 event should notify once. A repeated decide request must return ALREADY_REPORTED without sending another notification.
